basic_info.description: Charming 3 bedroom, 1 bath Bernal Heights home that has newly painted interior and front exterior; and new carpeting installed. Partial views of hills from front rooms of house and upper level of backyard. Kitchen has breakfast/eating area. Landscaped backyard on 2 flat levels. 1 car garage with room for storage. Laundry in garage. Close to shopping and dining on Cortland Avenue, as well as the Farmer's Market. Convenient to bus and freeway transportation corridors.
